Group departure

France Group — Sheng'ai Wellness Retreat, 6 Days / 5 Nights

A six-day stay at the Fuxian Lake base for a French group, structured by the twelve two-hour periods of the meridian clock rather than by clock hours. Every day carries the same spine — practice, breakfast, then either a consultation, a lecture, therapy or an excursion — with the evening closing on a herbal foot bath.

Request a Call

Day by day

  • Day 1 · Arrival and introductions

    Mao hour 06:00–07:00Airport pick-up; check-in; briefing on the six-day programme.
    Wu hour (11:00–13:00)Lunch and rest.
    Wei hour 14:00–Guided tour of the Sheng'ai health base.
    Shen hour 15:30–Herbal tea break, then a workshop making traditional pill, powder, paste and pellet preparations.
    You hour 18:00–19:30Nutritional dinner and rest.
    Xu hour 20:00–Sino-French welcome gathering — introductions all round.
    Hai hour 21:30–Herbal foot bath, formula adjusted to need. Rest.

  • Day 2 · Consultation and lecture

    Mao hour 06:00–07:00Run along the Caohai wetland (optional).
    Chen hour (07:00–09:00)Taiji or baduanjin practice, then breakfast, then physician consultation with nine-body-type identification and a treatment plan where needed.
    Si hour 10:30–Meditation lecture.
    Wu hour (11:00–13:00)Lunch and rest.
    Wei hour 14:00–TCM health lecture, then a half-day visit to the Cambrian fossil museum.
    Xu hour 20:00–Free time.
    Hai hour 21:30–Herbal foot bath.

  • Day 3 · Lake and fire

    Chen hour (07:00–09:00)Taiji or baduanjin practice, breakfast, then a herbal wellness morning tea.
    Si hour 10:30–Rest, then tuina for neck, shoulder or head.
    Wu hour (11:00–13:00)Lunch and rest.
    Wei hour 14:00–Boating on Fuxian Lake with local specialities.
    Xu hour 20:00–Bonfire gathering.
    Hai hour 21:30–Herbal foot bath.

  • Day 4 · Ridge walk and treatment

    Chen hour (07:00–09:00)Taiji or baduanjin practice, breakfast, then rest after the meal.
    Si hour 09:30–Jianshan ridge walk.
    Wu hour (11:00–13:00)Lunch and rest.
    Wei hour 14:00–Herbal tea break.
    Shen hour 16:00–TCM treatment — acupuncture, moxibustion and similar.
    Xu hour 20:00–Free time.
    Hai hour 21:30–Herbal foot bath.

  • Day 5 · The island

    Chen hour (07:00–09:00)Taiji or baduanjin practice, breakfast, then rest after the meal.
    Si hour 09:30–Tuina for neck, shoulder or head, then a meditation lecture.
    Wu hour (11:00–13:00)Lunch and rest.
    Wei hour 14:00–Half-day excursion to the island.
    Xu hour 20:00–Free time.
    Hai hour 21:30–Herbal foot bath.

  • Day 6 · Departure

    Chen hour (07:00–09:00)Taiji or baduanjin practice, breakfast, then rest after the meal.
    Si hour 09:30–Visit and shop the Sheng'ai product area.
    Wei hour 14:00–Departure.
